+@pytest.mark.sphinx('dummy')
+def test_info_field_list_var_type_xref(app, warning):
+    text = (".. py:class:: mod.A\n"
+            ".. py:class:: mod.submod.A\n"
+            "\n"
+            ".. py:currentmodule:: mod\n"
+            "\n"
+            ".. py:function:: f()\n"
+            "\n"
+            "   :param A a:\n"
+            "   :rtype: A\n"
+            "\n"
+            ".. py:currentmodule:: mod.submod\n"
+            "\n"
+            ".. py:function:: f()\n"
+            "\n"
+            "   :param A a:\n"
+            "   :rtype: A\n")
+    doctree = restructuredtext.parse(app, text)
+    refnodes = list(doctree.traverse(pending_xref))
+    assert len(refnodes) == 4
+
+    assert refnodes[0]['reftarget'] == 'A'
+    assert refnodes[0]['py:module'] == 'mod'
+    assert not refnodes[0].hasattr('refspecific')
+
+    assert refnodes[1]['reftarget'] == 'A'
+    assert refnodes[1]['py:module'] == 'mod'
+    assert not refnodes[1].hasattr('refspecific')
+
+    assert refnodes[2]['reftarget'] == 'A'
+    assert refnodes[2]['py:module'] == 'mod.submod'
+    assert not refnodes[2].hasattr('refspecific')
+
+    assert refnodes[3]['reftarget'] == 'A'
+    assert refnodes[3]['py:module'] == 'mod.submod'
+    assert not refnodes[3].hasattr('refspecific')
+
+    domain = app.env.get_domain('py')
+    node0 = domain.resolve_xref(app.env, 'index', app.builder, 'class', 'A', refnodes[0], nodes.Text('A'))
+    assert node0['reftitle'] == 'mod.A'
+    node1 = domain.resolve_xref(app.env, 'index', app.builder, 'class', 'A', refnodes[1], nodes.Text('A'))
+    assert node1['reftitle'] == 'mod.A'
+    node2 = domain.resolve_xref(app.env, 'index', app.builder, 'class', 'A', refnodes[2], nodes.Text('A'))
+    assert node2['reftitle'] == 'mod.submod.A'
+    node3 = domain.resolve_xref(app.env, 'index', app.builder, 'class', 'A', refnodes[3], nodes.Text('A'))
+    assert node3['reftitle'] == 'mod.submod.A'
+
+    assert 'more than one target found for cross-reference' not in warning.getvalue()
+
+    # Test prefix handling: '.' sets refspecific, '~' strips prefix
+    text2 = (".. py:function:: f()\n"
+             "\n"
+             "   :param .mod.A a:\n"
+             "   :param ~mod.A b:\n")
+    doctree2 = restructuredtext.parse(app, text2)
+    refnodes2 = list(doctree2.traverse(pending_xref))
+    assert len(refnodes2) == 2
+    assert refnodes2[0]['reftarget'] == 'mod.A'
+    assert refnodes2[0].astext() == 'mod.A'
+    assert refnodes2[0]['refspecific'] is True
+    assert refnodes2[1]['reftarget'] == 'mod.A'
+    assert refnodes2[1].astext() == 'A'
+    assert not refnodes2[1].hasattr('refspecific')

+

+        r2 = Restaurant.objects.create(name='Original2', address='123 Main')
+        orig_pk2 = r2.pk

+        r2.save()
+        self.assertNotEqual(r2.pk, orig_pk2)
+        self.assertEqual(Place.objects.get(pk=orig_pk2).name, 'Original2')
